subject: general
question: As per the Ministry of New And Renewable Energy. which state has the highest wind power potential as on March 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is " **Tamil Nadu** ".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tamil Nadu** tops the list of states with the largest installed wind power generation capacity in the country.
 
• Share of wind power in electricity generation was around **28% in 2018**.
 
• Total wind capacity at the end of 2018 stood at **8,631 MW** while its total installed electricity generation capacity stood at **30,447 MW** at the end of 2018.
